proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule XII, Table XII.1, what is the occupant load unit area for a classroom (educational occupancy)?

options.text: 0.65 sq.m per person — the same as an auditorium with fixed seating
1.80 sq.m per person — the standard unit area for classroom educational use
3.70 sq.m per person — for general office use and business occupancy
9.30 sq.m per person — for open-plan office and administrative areas

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Table XII.1 assigns 1.80 sq.m per person for classrooms. The auditorium value (0.65) applies to assembly with fixed or movable seating. Office space is 9.30 sq.m per person. The classroom value reflects higher occupant density than offices but lower than assembly spaces.
proposed.explanation: Knowing Table XII.1 unit areas by occupancy type is a direct recall task. The most commonly tested values are: auditorium 0.65, classroom 1.80, office 9.30, warehouse 28.00, and aircraft hangar 46.50 sq.m per person.
